Left out as not Ani's text: footnotes: p. 79 n. 1 (mark on 'sen', end of § F, p. 79 row 5): Var. em t'at'at àmt mitu ḳerḥ pui en àrit sàpt menta - set, "before the divine beings among the dead [on] night that of making judgment annihilated are they." See Naville, Todtenbuch, Bd. II., Bl. 79.; p. 79 n. 2 (mark on 'àmt', § G line 1, p. 79 row 6): Var. àm uat mita, "in the way of the dead."; p. 81 n. 1 (mark on 'āut', p. 81 row 1): Var. àbu.; p. 81 n. 2 (mark on 'àru', § I line 2, p. 81 row 8): Var. āā àru, "Mighty one of forms."; p. 81 n. 3 (mark on 'χepeś', p. 81 row 8): The papyrus of Nebseni adds t'at'a, "head." — variants and a Nebseni addition, not read as text.
